title: Saturating Differential Amplifier Model
constraints: `GAIN` and `VSAT` are `real` parameters / generics. The judge instantiates the model with `GAIN = 4.0`, `VSAT = 2.0`.
`vout = clamp(GAIN * (vp - vn), -VSAT, +VSAT)`, updated on each rising edge of `clk` (a clocked, sampled amplifier).
`vout` starts at `0.0` and holds between edges.
Checked with an absolute tolerance of 1e-9 V.
hints: This is exactly an op-amp difference amplifier with an output stage that can't swing past the supply rails: compute the ideal gain first, then clip it.
SystemVerilog: nest two `?:` (or two `if`s) around `GAIN * (vp - vn)`, comparing against `-VSAT` and `VSAT`. VHDL: two `if`s work the same way over `real` signals.
Clip the *result* of the multiply, not the inputs — `vp` and `vn` are never out of range themselves.

examples.title: clipped
examples.expected: vout = 2.0 (4 × 5 = 20, clipped to the +2.0 V rail)
